title: subscribe_events uses InvalidSession for SSE Content-Type mismatch
description: A caller who connects to the SSE endpoint and gets a 200 with wrong Content-Type (e.g. application/json) receives ClientError::InvalidSession. The variant doc says 'The JMAP Session object from the server was missing a required field.' A caller matching on InvalidSession in production will think their Session document is stale and re-fetch it — not that the SSE endpoint is misconfigured. The two failure modes (bad Session document vs. bad SSE response) are now indistinguishable. Fix: add a new ClientError::UnexpectedResponse(String) variant (pre-1.0, breaking is fine) and use it for protocol-level violations outside the Session fetch path.
